documents.title: Aurora current field manual
documents.content: The Aurora expedition uses amber beacons as its arrival signal. Its field leader is Mira Chen. This manual supersedes the old Aurora archive.

documents.title: Aurora current arrival log
documents.content: The Aurora expedition arrival was announced with amber beacons. The arrival observation window is dawn.

documents.title: Borealis field manual
documents.content: The Borealis expedition uses blue lanterns as its arrival signal. Its field leader is Ivo Reed. Borealis is separate from Aurora.

documents.title: Supply inventory
documents.content: The Aurora supply shipment contains twelve crates. Each crate carries a cobalt seal. The inventory contains no departure date or financial budget.

documents.title: Superseded Aurora archive
documents.content: An obsolete Aurora procedure used red flags for arrival. This archive is superseded by the current Aurora field manual; red flags are no longer the arrival signal.
